faq.q: Do you supply materials only, or install as well?
faq.a: Both. Choose material supply only, installation only, or complete supply and installation — or ask us to recommend the right model for your scope and budget.
Bengaluru and across Karnataka — from Whitefield workplaces to retail rollouts in towns like Gonikoppa. Larger programmes outside the state are considered case by case.

faq.q: What project sizes do you take on?
faq.a: Everything from focused ceiling, flooring or painting packages under ₹10 lakh to turnkey façade and fit-out programmes above ₹1 crore.

faq.q: How do I get prices for ACP sheets?
faq.a: All 63 current Superbond Diamond Edition shades are priced on request, based on quantity, thickness and site. Tap any shade for price and availability.

faq.q: Do I need drawings before I enquire?
faq.a: No. Site photos, an approximate area and the service you need are enough to start. If you need design support we’ll help define the scope — or try the AI Design Studio first.

faq.q: How does the AI Design Studio work?
faq.a: Upload a photo of your site or an inspiration image, explore material directions and match shades from the current catalogue. A supervisor validates the selection and shares a private quotation on WhatsApp.
A project lead — not a call centre — responds to every enquiry, usually within one working day.
